verdict.rationale: The API docs confirm that separate sandbox and live environments exist, each with its own OAuth/token authentication. That implies testing can happen apart from production. However, this is one passing mention, with no detail on how the sandbox behaves or how its data is isolated. Missing for 10: documentation of sandbox behavior and isolation from production data, test applicants or simulated report results, how to obtain and switch sandbox credentials, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
